review_cost.rationale: The required changes are small and mechanical but real: a reviewer would block on the goto option fix and the error-page status handling before approving, plus a handful of nits.

findings.issue: goto() is called with Kit 2 option names (keepFocus, noScroll, replaceState) that SvelteKit 3 removed/renamed to reset and replace; on the pinned @sveltejs/kit ^3 they are ignored, so every search/type/game change pushes a history entry and resets scroll and focus (the search input loses focus 200ms after typing).
findings.suggestion: Replace both call sites with goto(url, { reset: false, replace: true }) and verify focus and history behaviour manually.

findings.issue: Every error, including 500s from a failed PokeAPI fetch (app/src/lib/server/pokeapi.js:29 throws on non-ok), renders a page titled and headed 'Not found'.
findings.suggestion: Import page from $app/state and branch on page.status: show 'Not found' for 404s and a distinct internal-error message otherwise, per the current Kit error-page docs.

findings.issue: API_BASE_URL is read straight from process.env at module scope; SvelteKit 3's documented pattern is declaring it in src/env.js with defineEnvVars and consuming it via $app/env/private, which also gives validation.
findings.suggestion: Add src/env.js declaring API_BASE_URL (with default and URL validation) and import it in the server module.

findings.issue: The sprite URL pattern is duplicated (also built inline at app/src/routes/+page.server.js:79), and buildCard/hiddenCard are identical except the hidden flag.
findings.suggestion: Export one spriteUrl(id) helper and collapse buildCard/hiddenCard into buildCard(id, name, hidden = false).

findings.issue: Hiddenness reaches the card through two channels: the hidden prop (explicitly forwarded at app/src/routes/abilities/[name]/+page.svelte:19) and pokemon.hidden in the data; pokeapi.js:135 also reads a phantom item.hidden that no API shape has.
findings.suggestion: Drop the hidden prop and let the component read pokemon.hidden; remove the item.hidden fallback in buildCards.

findings.issue: The spec requires dex number, genus, types, artwork, height/weight and flavor text 'near the top (not in a section)', but they are wrapped in <section aria-label="Overview">, a named region the tests don't check for absence.
findings.suggestion: Use a plain <div> (or section without an accessible name) for the summary block.

findings.issue: The typesByPokemon and generationBySpecies maps (thousands of entries) are rebuilt on every request even though the underlying lists are cached in the server module.
findings.suggestion: Memoize the derived maps alongside getAllTypes/getAllGenerations in lib/server.

findings.issue: The '#lib/*' subpath-import mapping is used without module extensions (e.g. '#lib/format', '#lib/server/pokeapi'), while the SvelteKit 3 migration guide says such imports must include extensions; this relies on Vite's leniency rather than standard Node resolution.
findings.suggestion: Write '#lib/format.js' etc. (or keep a '#lib/x' convention consistently) so plain Node resolution also works.

findings.issue: untrack is unnecessary for an init-time snapshot (top-level reads aren't tracked), and the home title is hardcoded in the component while the server load already returns it (app/src/routes/+page.server.js:104), an inconsistency with the other pages that render data.title.
findings.suggestion: Drop untrack and render <title>{data.title}</title> like every other route.

findings.issue: All 700 lines of styling are global (no component has a <style> block), bypassing Svelte's scoped styles; classes are well-namespaced today but nothing enforces it as components grow.
findings.suggestion: Acceptable as a deliberate convention if documented in the README; otherwise move component-specific rules (card, move table) into scoped blocks.

summary: A genuinely modern SvelteKit 3 codebase — vite-plugin config, #lib alias, runes, clean server/client boundary, solid data loading and a11y structure — that would merge after one round of fixes. The blocking issue is that both programmatic goto() calls use option names Kit 3 removed, silently degrading search UX (focus/scroll loss, history pollution) in ways the URL-based tests can't see. Secondary asks: make +error.svelte status-aware, declare API_BASE_URL via src/env.js, and trim small duplications.
